StringWithMarkup.String: Tetranitromethane appears as a pale yellow liquid. Irritates skin and respiratory tract. Very toxic by inhalation. Difficult to ignite. Burns at a steady rate once ignited. Under prolonged exposure to fire or heat containers may rupture violently and rocket Produces toxic oxides of nitrogen during combustion.
Colorless to pale-yellow liquid or solid (below 57 degrees F) with a pungent odor; [NIOSH]
